criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register right and the hero modelled properly. Several frames lean: 5 mitten hand, shapeless sleeve, rigid sheet; 3 far lid moire, flat lid cards, blown hero top, rippled lawn, no seam; 8 clone mannequins, grey floor, cite line over the laptop; 9 a translucent dark rectangle at left and a jagged seat lip; 1, 6 and 7 hovering pavers and flat inlays; 7 a smear behind the kicker; 4 no lawn above the lid.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: A filmstrip: one desk, one key, one world and grade, no strobe, two devices visible; 8 outside the world and 4 drops the lawn.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; labels and the quote match verbatim; first-ever stays the college's word. c18 a fair reading at medium confidence; slide 9's invitation leans on c16 broadly.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and what to do; slide 7 names what is missing; no frame says what the policy would change for students.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays, 4 turns, 7 a second beat, the close lands; plain cover; 5 and 8 restate.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, attributed, on register; boilerplate attribution and disclaimers; little Texas placing beyond campus names.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The kit student desk and instanced desk rows were no. 38's spine ten days ago; lastLight and one unit per day repeat no. 46; the interior from behind repeats nos. 45 and 47.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the walk the deck is built on, sunk pavers with soil joints and polished granite on turf, then recut 5 and 8 so no kit person is a frame's subject.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A two-finger mitten hand, a shapeless sleeve, a rigid sheet in the air.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the person; a low raking close on the desk top with the sheet flat on the laminate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Moire on far lids, flat lid cards, a blown hero top, rippled lawn, no seam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Longer lens toward a visible seam, mip-mapped dim lids, the hero top exposed down.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Clone mannequins, a mid tone floor, the cite line over the laptop.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Empty the room to seats, the lectern alone in the window's pool, the floor darkened.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A translucent dark rectangle at left; a jagged seat lip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove or fog the occluder; fix the seat shell's front edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Hovering pavers on a water-like lawn, flat red inlays, a small desk.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sunk pavers with soil joints, polished inlays, camera two pavers closer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A smear behind the kicker; a floating paver over a blank slab; the book tiny.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in to the close on the shut lid and the paperback; fog the oak behind the type.
